To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have studied the asymmetric neutrino absorption/scattering cross section on hot and dense neutron-star matter in fully relativistic approach and have calculated the neutrino transport equation with these cross sections in 1D.

the neutrino absorption and the neutrino scattering on the hot and dense magnetar matter are asymmetric incoherently, and the neutrino absorption is enhanced in the direction of magnetic field, and the neutrinos are absorbed more efficiently in the direction of B, which results in the asymmetric kick of the proto-neutron stars.
the asymmetry is 3–4% at ρ0 ≤ρB ≤ 3 ρ0 and T ≤ 30 MeV for B = B0 = 2 ×1017 G, which is the typical value for the magnetized neutron star.

the neutrino transport and the neutrino-induced n → H kick velocity on a proto-neutron star in the early stage of supernova explosions.
the asymmetric neutrino absorption/scattering on hot and dense matter including hyperons.
the effect of strong magnetic field on the neutrino transport and the kick velocity in magnetized proto-neutron star.

the asymmetric kick velocity of proto-neutron stars is not so large, and the magnetic field is not so strong.

a proto-neutron star is a good candidate to generate the asymmetric neutrino emission and kick velocity for the neutron-star binary system.

the magnetic field in a proto-neutron star is important for the neutrino absorption/scattering and the kick velocity.

the magnetic field of proto-neutron stars can be a source of the asymmetric neutrino absorption/scattering and the kick velocity.
